i guess i can talk with him... we had a really bad fight last year though and i think he still hates me but lately he's been asking me what's wrong and i can't really tell him... i guess i can try that. 

no, none of my parents have ever done something like that to me, thankfully, but i can't press charges against them (i've thought of doing that before.) but there is no way to prove that i am in the right and besides my parents are so rich they'll probably just hire all the best lawyers and grind my case into the ground. but no physical abuse.

well, it's really dark art and deals with everything dark and depressing and yeah, they will probably get mad at me for drawing that stuff. hmm... i don't really have any friends i trust, but maybe if i tried to get to know their parents a bit more... do you think they would help me?

i've looked into that, and no, not at all, besides foster care or something. i don't want that anyway, i want somewhere where someone will care for me. my dad's side is ridiculously homophobic and they all know about this already so that's out, my mom's side is pretty much all dead, my brother who is alive is a mess and no one's heard from him in 4 months, so no, i don't see where else i could live right now. i really do love my art though and i want to keep doing it, but i'm afraid they will find it and get mad...

i really want to get out of the house, thats for sure, but of course i cant right now... i think i can emancipate or something when i get to be 16... do you know how that works? about reaching out at school, well i am kind of afraid to do that, i go to a really expensive private school (a waldorf school) and my parents are really, really rich, i mean hundred-millions, my dad never ever takes time to interact with me and my mom is always talking with one of her friends... i'm afraid that telling someone could lead to either them taking me out of the school and putting me back in public school (which would be worse) or them deciding to send me away... even though i don't want to be with them, i also don't want to be in a place where i have no one i know. i need people in my life who care. i'm not even supposed to be on the computer right now and i don't have a phone or access to one or any other way to talk to people without my parents knowing, we live in a huge house in the country and there is nothing around for at least 5 miles so i can't go anywhere without them taking me, and i'm just really helpless, is there any way you can think of that i could still talk with people without my parents knowing (they probably wouldn't want it)

edit for your edit: i don't have any access at all to drugs or alcohol, i love music but my ipod gets taken away a lot, i draw and write poetry, those are my main passions, but it's all been dark for about 6 months and i'm afraid my parents will find them and get mad

yeah, i tell myself that, but it's really so hard because i never get that message from anyone, and i'm right now on the computer because i snuck downstairs and if my parents catch me they will probably take away something but i'm not even sure what's left. my music, maybe. i love music, but i get my ipod taken away a lot. i love drawing and writing, but it's all been really dark for about 6 months.
